content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a free service that allows users to host static websites directly from their GitHub repositories. This platform is particularly relevant for digital creators in countries with limited access to traditional payment gateways. By leveraging GitHub Pages, creators can set up an online store that is not only cost-effective but also free from the high transaction fees typically associated with platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10% on each sale. Utilizing GitHub Pages allows creators to retain more of their revenue, making it a vital tool for anyone looking to sell digital products without incurring significant costs.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a GitHub Pages store typically involves a combination of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to create a user-friendly interface. Hosting is done via GitHub’s infrastructure, eliminating costs associated with traditional hosting services. Payment processing can be handled through NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and only charges a 0.5% fee per transaction. This combination allows for seamless product delivery and automatic payment verification, ensuring that creators can manage their stores effortlessly while focusing on their products. The scalability of this architecture means that as sales increase, the infrastructure can handle the load without unnecessary overhead.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are either unavailable or prohibitively expensive. This includes artists, educators, and software developers in countries like Nigeria, Kenya, and Venezuela. By providing a structure that doesn't rely on traditional payment processors, creators can build a sustainable business model that respects their sovereignty and maximizes their profits. GitHub Pages enables these creators to maintain control over their content and financial transactions, allowing them to thrive in a challenging economic landscape.
GitHub Pages allows for a cost-free hosting solution.
The Components That Make It Work Together

To successfully deploy a digital product store using GitHub Pages, several key components are essential. First, your website is hosted on GitHub Pages, enabling free access and easy updates. Next, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers can be utilized for backend logic, facilitating automated tasks like order processing. For product storage, Supabase or Google Sheets offer a reliable database solution. Finally, integrating NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions allows you to accept payments without relying on traditional banking systems, ensuring a smooth transaction process for your customers.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your digital product store using GitHub Pages, start by creating a GitHub account and setting up a new repository. Next, design your website using HTML and CSS, focusing on a user-friendly layout. Implement backend logic with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to manage your product offerings. Store your product files using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for easy access and delivery. Finally, integrate NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring that you can accept payments securely. This streamlined approach will allow you to launch your store quickly and efficiently.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
NOWPayments slashes transaction fees drastically.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

Utilize GitHub Pages for hosting your ebook store. Integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions, allowing you to sell without relying on traditional payment processors.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?
By using GitHub Pages alongside NOWPayments, you can avoid platform fees. Unlike Gumroad, which charges 10%, NOWPayments only takes a 0.5% fee.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, you can host your templates and fonts on GitHub Pages. Combine this with NOWPayments to process transactions directly without third-party platforms.
What are the advantages of using GitHub Pages for my store?
GitHub Pages provides free hosting, allowing you to retain all your sales revenue. It also offers a straightforward setup and control over your digital products.
How can I automate product delivery?
Use Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to automate the delivery of your digital products upon payment confirmation, ensuring a seamless customer experience.
